description: GET /v1/merchants/me - the merchant's profile: id, walletAddress, name, email, onboardingCompleted, the settlement policy (stakingMode, stakingThresholdUsd, underpaymentToleranceBps, normalizePayoutChainId, normalizePayoutAddress), the processing settings (processingPaymentMode, processingExpenseLimitBps) and serviceFeePayer. The profile is the same in Test and Live. Uses a cached sk_* key, else a fresh JWT. Read-only.
name: merchant_get
title: Get merchant profile
